selection: second/final development hypothesis passes predeclared mean+0.005 and no-day-harm>0.01 criteria; no final data used

temporal.input: raw counts with training-only channel mean/std
temporal.target: training-only masked target mean/std; invert before scoring
temporal.architecture: 176->32 k3 d1 ReLU ->32 k3 d2 ReLU ->32 k3 d4 ReLU ->7 linear
temporal.loss: mean squared standardized target error on supplied training masks after burnin
temporal.checkpoint: last epoch, fixed in advance; no evaluation-based early stopping
temporal.pilot: prior fixed-TCN pilot already established local training cost; no new pilot
temporal.augmentation: Independent perchunk/perchannel Bernoulli keep probability0.9, constant across time including burn-in; replace standardized missing channel with0, no inverted scaling; seeded Torch RNG during training only
temporal.hypothesis: Exposure to missing standardized channels may reduce reliance on individual observation channels and improve forward-day performance; unstable channels are a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause

decision.fallback: retain original fixed TCN; no further augmentation search

adaptation: not retained; first hypothesis did not support bounded correction rationale

calibration_stretch.state: all preceding neural bins, reset each file
